'''Killer''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served with [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Killer flew a [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|clone Z-95 starfighter]] when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] launched an [[Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet/Legends|assault]] on [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], but he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was shot down by [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]].
